extracted.name: Lamb koftas
extracted.description: With only five ingredients, these lean meatballs couldn't be any easier to make.
instruction_lines: Mix together all the ingredients until well blended. Divide into eight balls, then roll each ball on a board with a cupped hand to turn them into ovals. Thread onto four metal skewers and brush with oil.
To cook on a griddle: heat the pan until you can feel a good heat rising and cook for 3-4 mins each side. Don’t turn until they are well sealed or the meat will stick to the grill or pan.
Season if you want, and set aside. Serve the koftas with yogurt and spiced flat breads.
